name: Velzie
source:
Velzie is a mysterious and lucid thoughtform that is found in Akizet's personal corrucyst. It possesses abnormal abilities in manipulating thoughtforms and thoughtspaces. Its intentions are currently unknown and consistently asks the Interloper to restore the cyst in order to receive the answers it is withholding about Akizet's past and disappearance. It has specifically expressed interest in restoring the cyst's communication capabilities.

For a currently unknown reason, it shares the same name of the obeski deity. 

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Velzie]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
